name: How long do whole house water filters last, and how often do they need maintenance?

mainEntity.name: How long do whole house water filters last, and how often do they need maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of whole house water filters varies, typically ranging from 3 months to 10 years, depending on the filter type, water quality, and household water usage. Sediment filters may need changing every 3-6 months, while carbon filters can last 6-12 months. Water softeners often require periodic salt replenishment and resin bed cleaning. Regular maintenance is crucial to ensure the system performs effectively and to prolong its lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Whole house filter lifespan varies (3 months to 10 years) by type and usage; regular maintenance, including filter changes, is essential for performance.
